capabilities: Insert emojis and classic smileys via short codes while typing
Define custom code maps with any short-code format for symbols and snippets
Configure token text highlighting rulesets for named code blocks
extras: Includes a demo video; user-defined code maps require manually creating JSON files in the plugin's data folder.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to expand typed short codes into emojis, special characters or frequently used snippets.
summary: Short-code expander that inserts emojis, smileys, symbols and user-defined snippets as you type codes like :smile: or /prog-50.
